findings.title: Host port is taken on every node
findings.cause: no node can run the pod: 1 node has hostPort 8081 in use already; Deployment web has 1 of 2 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't have free ports for the requested pod ports. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 No preemption victims found for incoming pod.

evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-7d46598d5d-gw8sj -n kd-hostport-conflict -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[*].ports}'

findings.fix: Drop hostPort and reach the pod through a Service, or run at most one such pod per node (a DaemonSet, or fewer replicas than nodes).
